Subject: Procurement gates & expected timeline — legal / security / finance check-in

Thanks again for the call today — quick recap and proposed mutual action plan so we all have the same expectations.

Key procurement gates (what we discussed):
- Legal review (master services agreement + SOW)
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence review
- Finance payment path decision (PO vs card vs cloud marketplace)
- PO issuance / contract signature

Medisys ask items we agreed to collect this week:
1) List of procurement contacts and system (ProcureOps or Ariba) — Tom to confirm.
2) Any required contract redlines to the MSA — Elena to flag by Fri 8/20.
3) Security questionnaire items for prioritization — Ben will drop SOC2 brief and a short answers doc.

Target timeline (provisional):
- Legal kickoff / initial review: week of 8/23
- Security evidence handoff: by 8/24
- Finance decision on payment instrument: by 8/27
- Expected PO issuance (if PO route): target by 9/3

Next steps from Redwood:
- Sending SOW draft and SOC2 summary (attached).
- Ben to schedule a short security Q&A (30 min) with your InfoSec reviewer.

Action owners:
- Vivek: coordinate legal cadence and sign-off plan.
- Ben: security evidence + Q&A.
- Lauren: commercial / pricing clarifications and marketplace options.

Please reply with any missing owners or changes to the timeline. If PO is tight, we can explore a temporary card commit + invoice or marketplace listing to accelerate onboarding.

Regards,

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vivek — that matches our internal view. A few clarifications from the procurement side:

1) Legal: we need a copy of your standard MSA. If there are customer-friendly clauses (data residency, breach notification timelines) that would be helpful to call out.
2) Security: we'll have our InfoSec team review the SOC2 brief first. Can Ben confirm if you provide a continuous evidence link or just point-in-time report?
3) Finance: our default is PO for vendor commitments > $50k ARR, but we can do a temporary card-based purchase for pilots if needed.

Tom (cc'd) will confirm ProcureOps intake method and whether they prefer a DocuSign or an upload to the vendor portal.

Elena
Director, Procurement
Medisys Health

- SOC2: we can provide the latest SOC2 Type II report (FY25) and a 1-page continuous controls summary for key controls (access, encryption, logging).
- Evidence: we host a secure shared folder for redacted artifacts and provide short walkthroughs for reviewers. If you prefer an on-site review call, we can schedule one next week.

Proposed immediate items from security side:
• I will send the SOC2 PDF and the controls summary by EOD Thu (attached).
• Suggest a 30-min technical sync with your InfoSec on Mon 8/24 at 10am PT — confirm if that works.

Marketplace note for Lauren: we can provision a marketplace listing (AWS/GCP/Azure) but time-to-live for that is typically 3–4 weeks; it's a good longer-term acceleration if Medisys wants procurement via marketplace.

Ben

- Legal initial review: 8/24–8/26 (internal counsel)
- Security review (InfoSec): 8/26–8/28 — expecting SOC2 summary and short Q&A; Ben's proposed sync on 8/24 is okay if earlier.
- Finance review & approval: 8/27–9/2 (depends on PO thresholds)
